name: Shared data from snapshot tables (SOURCE=objects)
summary: Page -> serve -> session -> load_shared -> cache.get -> sf.rows -> TBL_ACCESS_ tables; Rebuild CALLs SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT and drops the cache

name: Shared data read directly (SOURCE=direct)
summary: Load shared data click -> reload(load) -> cache.get -> access.live() over ACCOUNT_USAGE or SHOW fallback

name: Web API request
summary: Browser fetch -> same_site middleware (Host, Origin, Sec-Fetch-Site) -> route -> serve -> session -> ROUTES handler -> JSON

name: Streamlit in Snowflake
summary: app.py -> st_react.app component -> answer() bridge -> server.py functions; INSIDE session, never closed, memory only, My access hidden

name: My access
summary: POST /api/mine/load -> mine_off checks -> access.mine() with the user's own rights -> MINE[sid] + ae_sid cookie -> view=mine pages

name: Startup
summary: run.py parses mode/port/source, sets env, starts server.py (uvicorn 8000) or streamlit app.py (8501); server import runs cache.config

name: What changed
summary: cache.keep_prev keeps <key>.prev.pkl; changes_page loads cache.prev (fake: fake_previous) and a.diff compares facts()

name: serve
summary: JSON answer of one endpoint: session + ROUTES handler + refs + clean

name: session
summary: Builds the view's lookups under LOCK; shared via load_shared, mine via MINE[sid]

name: load_shared
summary: Shared data via cache.get; direct mode refuses page-triggered reads (409 shared_not_loaded)

name: read_shared
summary: fake() / with_query(live) / with_query(snapshot) by MODE and SOURCE

name: with_query
summary: One connection, query() over sf.rows, closed only when sf.owned()

name: reload
summary: POST /api/reload: rebuild (CALL SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT), load, page; drops cache

name: meta
summary: App metadata: mode, source, pages, mine_available, inside, run, notes

name: home_page
summary: Home JSON: ladder counts, risks by severity, protection

name: changes_page
summary: What changed JSON: previous snapshot, diff, filter by subject

name: mine_off
summary: Why My access is off: INSIDE, MY_ACCESS, HOST not loopback or ALLOWED_HOSTS naming another host, key-pair login

name: load_mine
summary: Reads the user's own access (a.mine or a.only demo), builds it, stores MINE[sid]

name: mine_entry
summary: MINE entry of a sid, dropped after TTL

name: allowed_hosts
summary: Host names served: loopback, HOST, machine names/IPs on 0.0.0.0, ALLOWED_HOSTS

name: make_app
summary: FastAPI app: gzip, same_site middleware, error handlers, /api routes, SPA

name: same_site
summary: Middleware: 400 bad_host, 403 cross_site (Origin, Sec-Fetch-Site)

name: mine_load
summary: POST /api/mine/load: new sid, load_mine, ae_sid cookie

name: config
summary: (mode, source, where) from FAKE / SOURCE / ACCESS_SNAPSHOT

name: name
summary: Cache key: account + source + location + user + role

name: get
summary: Memory (24 h) -> .cache file (CACHE_HOURS) -> fn(); writes SQL copy, prev, pkl

name: ready
summary: Whether get() answers without reading the source

name: drop
summary: Out of memory; local file set aside as .old.pkl

name: keep_prev
summary: Replaced file of another run becomes <key>.prev.pkl

name: prev
summary: (data, mtime) of the previous snapshot kept locally

name: local
summary: Local file allowed: CACHE_HOURS > 0 and not INSIDE

name: sql_copy
summary: DuckDB copy of each read as TBL_ACCESS_ tables, previous as _PREV

name: sql_wanted
summary: SQL copy only outside Snowflake, DUCKDB!=0, disk or DUCKDB=1

name: connect
summary: INSIDE: app session; else key pair or SSO externalbrowser

name: owned
summary: Connection is ours to close (not INSIDE)

name: rows
summary: Every Snowflake read: (columns, rows) of one statement

name: in_snowflake
summary: INSIDE detection: FAKE, INSIDE=0|1, active Snowpark session

name: snapshot
summary: The last OK run of the snapshot tables. query(sql) -> list of dicts; where = DB.SCHEMA of the tables; ACTIVITY rows go through hours_of (HOURS JSON text -> dict).

name: live
summary: Whole account read now with the caller's role; same dict as snapshot()

name: each
summary: Statements SHOW_THREADS at a time; exceptions returned

name: mine
summary: The logged-in user's own access, live, read-only

name: only
summary: Demo of mine(): one user's slice of a data set

name: build
summary: Fills module lookups; same key skips; keeps KEEP_BUILT data sets

name: cached
summary: fn() once per data set (memo)

name: loaded
summary: Lookups of another data set inside a block, restored after

name: facts
summary: What a diff compares, once per data set

name: diff
summary: Events, counts, new/fixed findings from prev to the loaded data set

name: grant_events
summary: Gain/lose events from added/removed grants and user roles

name: event_counts
summary: Events per filter: all, gain, lose, risk, sensitive

name: fake_previous
summary: Demo earlier snapshot for What changed

name: answer
summary: One API call of the React app answered by server.py: (status, body, sid)

name: app
summary: Whole React app as one component; answers requests, mirrors URL, reruns

name: app.py
summary: Streamlit entry: page setup, blocked-component hint, st_react.app()

name: run.py
summary: Launcher: web|streamlit, --fake, --direct/--objects, --port

name: SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT
summary: Owner's-rights Python procedure filling the TBL_ACCESS_ tables; run() skips if RUNNING

name: get
summary: Cached GET /api/... via fetch or the Streamlit transport

name: startApp
summary: Installs the Streamlit transport: requests queued and sent as component value

name: What changed
summary: Changes page fetching /api/changes

name: POST /api/reload
summary: Reload / load / rebuild

name: POST /api/mine/load
summary: Load My access

name: GET /api/changes
summary: What changed JSON (route per page name)

name: GET /api/home
summary: Home JSON (route per page name)

name: Table activity read (snapshot and direct, incremental)
summary: SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT activity() or access.live() read only the days the last read lacks from ACCESS_HISTORY + QUERY_HISTORY + SESSIONS (app's QUERY_TAG left out) into TBL_ACCESS_ACTIVITY / the ACTIVITY key, per UTC day with HOURS (queries per UTC hour) and APP (Streamlit app); hours_of parses HOURS; build() fills acts

name: Activity tab request
summary: Object or Access page Activity tab (or the Access for UseLine) -> GET /api/activity -> activity_page -> kind branch (warehouse / app / scope / object), act_state, activity, activity_graph, activity_sensitive, query_sql, app_use, mark_sensitive, rule >= 24 findings -> stacked access log

name: SQL behind a page
summary: SQL button or right-click -> SqlPanel -> GET /api/sql -> sql_page -> page_sql -> query_file / plain / activity_section_sql -> SqlBox; Activity sections via section_sql -> Sec SQL button
